column1: # Extra columns for words.txt, merged by assemble.mjs. word<TAB>also_right<TAB>banned
# also_right: guesses accepted as right (spellings, short forms, US/UK names);
#   the matcher also rejects them as clues.
# banned: clues rejected as "too close": obvious translations (es, fr, de, it;
#   accents optional, the matcher folds them), skipping forms that are
#   English words a player might fairly use (pan, pain, latte, stern, sale).
